head: sarva
target: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs de las ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / mi rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / yi dgas rnams dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa rnams dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sems dang sems las byung ba lhag par g.yo ba dang bral bar g.yo ba dag rab tu shes shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin

target: bcom ldan 'das gal te dam pa'i chos spong ba dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dag la the tsom du gyur pa gang lags pa ma gtogs par mtshams ma mchis pa lnga bgyid pa zhig lags na yang bdag gis re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par ma bgyis par gyur na/ lam ma yin par zhugs pa la/ lam nye bar ston pa gang yin pa dang / bdag cag sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten las yongs su thar bar bya ba'i phyir/ lam ma yin par zhugs pa la lam nye bar ston pa gang yin pa dang / bdag cag sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten las yongs su thar bar bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa byed pa gang yin pa de ni bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do snyam du sems bskyed par yang bya'o/ /
src_sentence: yo'smābhiḥ śrutam apathagāmināṃ pathamupadarśayati anarthe arthasaṃjñinām anitye nityasaṃjñinām asukhe sukhasaṃjñināṃ yadasmābhirnarakatiryogyoniyamalokaparimokṣaṇārthaṃ  #

head: kula
target: chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa ni yang khyod legs so/ / rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud na spyod par 'gyur te/ der yang dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang / blon po chen po dang / blon po snod du gyur pa mchod pa byed pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud na spyod par 'gyur te/ der yang dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang / blon po chen po dang / blon po snod du gyur pa mchod pa byed pa/
src_sentence: ayaṃ ca kulaputra dharmaparyāyaḥ paścime kāle paścime samaye dakṣiṇāpathe pracariṣyati tatrāpi bhikṣubhikṣuṇyupāsakopāsikārājarājaputramahāmātrāmātyā  #

target: byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad dang / nyan thos chen po de dag thams cad dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba de dag thams cad dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin chen mo dpe med ma dang / dri med 'od dang / 'od can ma dang / 'jigs byed ma dang / dpal ldan ma dang / dung can ma dang / 'phrog ma la sogs pa de dag dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / 'jam dpal dang / lag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad dang / nyan thos chen po de dag thams cad dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba de dag thams cad dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin chen mo dpe med ma dang / dri med 'od dang / 'od can ma dang / /
